name: Face Wash | Chando Naturals Aloe Vera Beauty Face Wash 100ml Gentle Hydrating Cleanser for Sensitive Skin
description:
Soothe and refresh your skin naturally with Chando Naturals Aloe Vera Beauty Face Wash. Enriched with pure aloe vera extract, this gentle cleanser hydrates while removing dirt, oil, and impurities. It calms irritation, reduces redness, and supports a healthy glow without stripping the skin’s natural moisture. Perfect for daily use, especially on sensitive or dry skin, it leaves the complexion soft, supple, and refreshed after every wash.Key Features:
 Size: 100ml tube
 Infused with aloe vera for natural soothing care
 Hydrates and cleanses without over-drying
 Calms redness, irritation, and sun-stressed skin
 Gentle formula suitable for sensitive and dry skin
 Maintains skin’s natural moisture balanceHow to Use:
 Wet face with water
 Apply a small amount of face wash and lather
 Massage gently in circular motions
 Rinse thoroughly and pat dry
 Use daily for soft and refreshed skinIngredients:
Aloe vera extract, Aqua, Glycerin, Mild cleansing agents, Natural soothing compoundsSafety Information:
 For external use only
 Avoid contact with eyes; rinse immediately if contact occurs

 Keep out of reach of children
